question: Which ministry is implementing the ‘PM DAKSH’ scheme ?

options.text: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, in collaboration with NeGD, has developed this portal.
 
• Social Justice and Empowerment Minister Dr Virendra Kumar launched the PM-DAKSH portal and mobile application on 7 August 2021.
 
• It will make the skill development schemes accessible to the target groups of backward classes, Scheduled Castes, and safai karamcharis.
 
• The Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH) Yojana is implemented from 2020-21.
